correctness.rationale: The complete proof identifies suffix and singleton query supports, forces every nonterminal adaptive query to be a suffix, obtains a partition into 2^(d-1) consecutive blocks with at least two leaves each, and constructs a matching balanced suffix-query tree. Greedy packing is justified by earliest-end exchange. VC dimension follows from ancestor comparability. Direct independent finite recursion agrees for all 1,023 ordered profiles through ten leaves.

value.rationale: Exact dimensions for arbitrary positive multiplicities on a natural infinite family of rooted hierarchy path concepts; linear-time optimal mistake-bound computation; and a sharp non-obvious ordering dependence: profiles (1,1,2,2,1,1) and (1,2,1,2,1,1) have the same six levels, eight leaves and multiplicity multiset yet online ranks three and two. Thus quantitative shattering cannot be inferred from cardinality, profile multiset or textbook threshold dimension alone.
